## v1.8.9 — Settings UX, audit tools, icons, themes

Settings cleanup, audit tooling, Add App icon gallery, and a theme overhaul (five replacements + true Light/Dark variants).

### Added

- **Audit Log tools** — paginate 30/page, search + action filters, Remove all history, CSV export (`scope=ops`)
- **System Update History tools** — same pagination; clear/export only `system_update_*` rows
- **Audit API** — `GET /api/audit?limit=&offset=&scope=`, `POST /api/audit/clear`, `GET /api/audit/export`
- **Icon gallery** — `GET /api/logos` + searchable picker in Add/Edit App (Upload still available)
- **Five new themes** — Ember Hearth, Neon Boulevard, Kelp Abyss, Amber Console, Glacier Mist (deep-gray darks, light variants, unique icon packs)

### Changed

- **Infrastructure** — Settings “Integrations” renamed; stale media-servers subtitle fixed
- **Home Assistant** — configure via Add/Edit App (Integration = Home Assistant); Settings Smart Home tab removed; poller prefers HA app credentials
- **Branding** — donation/support folded into Branding; Support sidebar removed
- **Theme Mode** — **Light / Dark** is a variant of the selected gallery theme (`data-theme-id` on `<html>`); control lives next to Theme Gallery
- **Per-theme chrome icons** — unique packs (including Default, Luxury Gold, Taghawsa)
- RSS settings banner points to **Performance**

### Removed

- Themes: `sunset-warm`, `vaporwave-grid`, `ocean-depths`, `terminal-amber`, `arctic-frost` (saved IDs sanitize to `default`)
- Add App “News feeds → Settings → RSS Feeds” help line
- Dark-mode-only theme warning

### Upgrade

```bash
./update-amud.sh
```

Hard-refresh once (Ctrl+Shift+R) after update so theme-engine / logo-picker / SW pick up.

**Recommended:** `v1.8.9`
